title.text: The cards of the kiosk with objects

runs.text: Place each kiosk responsibility in the piece whose job it is.

Each responsibility goes to whoever has the information: the price, the stock, the way of charging and the total live in different pieces. What is shown is the receipt's job, even if in a small program it can stay in the main algorithm.
Computing the amount of a quantity.
Knowing how much is left of each product.
Taking away from the stock only if there is enough.
Charging an amount with or without surcharge.
Gathering the total of the sales.
Applying the discount to the total.
Writing the rejections with their reason.
